description: Read a reference clip (absolute path under the media dir) as a format: its shots with lengths, the transition into each (cut, fade, fadeblack), light or dark ground, where the main element sits on a 3x3 grid and motion, plus the rhythm. Returns binding rules: build one section per shot, in order. Samples every 0.25 s for up to 2 minutes; a longer clip is sampled evenly, so its shots are coarser. Pair with extract_style for the palette. The format only: never copies subjects, logos or text.

path.description: Absolute path of a reference clip under the media dir.
